text:
Erica H: @channel final go/no-go for Dorado private rollout tomorrow 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC. Plan: pin v1.12.3-rc2, canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%. DB migration is additive-only. Need infra + CS ack. Release notes below:

```release notes
- runtime: 1.12.3-rc2 (batching + kv-cache fixes)
- perf: lowered p99 token latency on A100s by ~8%
- infra: safer startup ordering for model shards
- migrations: add `serve_flags` column (nullable)
- rollback: supported to v1.11.9 without data loss
```

Erica H: Deploybot will run a health gate after each phase (latency p95 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%). If gate fails, automatic rollback to pinned version. Reply with approvals.

DeployBot: Scheduled rollout for tenant `dorado`:
- 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z canary (5%)
- 2026-04-01T02:20:00Z ramp to 50% (if gates pass)
- 2026-04-01T02:50:00Z full (if gates pass)
Gates: latency, 5xx rate, customer smoke tests.
Audit ID: rb-2234567890-01

Mike L: infra checks done. GPU pool reserved for window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Autoscaler warm pools at 10% headroom. :thumbsup:

Sanjay P: CS confirmed Dorado accepts 02:00-04:00 UTC. Customer-side smoke tests will run at canary and 50%. I'll notify PM and CS lead now.

Julia K: Quick Q — what's the exact rollback command if we need to abort? Also who's on-call to approve emergency rollback?

Erica H: Rollback command: ```bash
redwoodctl tenant rollback --tenant dorado --to-tag v1.11.9 --force
```
On-call: Julia K (SRE), Mike L (Infra), and Sanjay P (CS) will make the go/no-go. Erica will do the pin/unpin.

DeployBot: Canary gate thresholds: p95 latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%, model output drift < 3% on evalset A. Failure triggers automated halt and alert to #incidents.

Mike L: Confirming autoscaler hooks and healthchecks. I ran the smoke script against a staging slice — all green.

Sanjay P: Approved from CS side. Sending customer opt-in message now.

Erica H: Pinning version 1.12.3-rc2 in tenant config now: `tenant.dorado.serving.version = "1.12.3-rc2"`. Will kick off at 02:00 UTC. If any regression, call the rollback command and flag the ticket.

Ops-Bot: Audit log created: https://console.redwood.ai/audit/rb-2234567890-01 (perms: eng+cs).

Julia K: I will watch logs and run smoke tests live. If I see >0.4% 5xx or p95 > 200ms at canary, I'll request halt and run rollback. Standby pager: page 2.

Erica H: Thanks — final: Mike + Julia + Sanjay have acked. Proceeding with scheduled rollout. I'll post a quick status thread during the window. :rocket:
